specimen:
Do I contradict myself?
Very well then I contradict myself,
(I am large, I contain multitudes.)
hook: This contradiction has stood unedited for 170 years.
tell: Whitman never resolves the contradiction — he just restates it flatly with 'Very well then' and moves on. A model asked to write this would almost always add a justifying clause tying the two claims together logically. Whitman instead drops an unconnected parenthetical as his only follow-up, leaving the contradiction standing on its own.
title: He contradicts himself and never fixes it. Real or AI?
caption: A model would explain the contradiction away. Whitman just states it and walks off. Did you catch the parenthetical?
cta: New specimen every morning, afternoon and night.
